principle.label: Product Architecture
principle.title: Two decisions. One coherent gas path.
principle.description: A PSA system is an optional upstream nitrogen source. If mixed-gas cutting is required, the integrated cabinet and MSPV2_4000 perform the same core function—choose one according to installation form and integration responsibility.
principle.flow1Desc: Generate nitrogen on site when the required flow, purity, pressure and operating profile justify a dedicated source.
principle.flow2Desc: Retain a suitable liquid, bulk or cylinder supply when it already meets the confirmed process demand.
principle.flow3Desc: Packaged external N₂/O₂ ratio, pressure and flow control with less surrounding integration work.
principle.flow4Desc: Compact N₂/O₂ control for OEM, retrofit or near-machine integration where the customer owns the surrounding engineering.
principle.specDesc: Review the existing source first. Add PSA only when it is the appropriate upstream supply for the project.
principle.dimsDesc: The cabinet and compact valve are alternative products with the same core function. Choose one—not a serial pair.
principle.cutEffectDesc: Pure-nitrogen cutting bypasses mixed-gas control. If mixed gas is selected, choose one controller by gas conditions, space, interfaces and engineering responsibility.
principle.compatDesc: Send the machine, material, gas-source and installation conditions for an application review.

advantages.label: Engineering Resources
advantages.title: Evaluate the project at the right level
advantages.description: Use the homepage to understand the complete assist-gas path. Open the relevant resource when you need operating-impact estimates, cabinet cutting parameters, or recorded cabinet evidence.
advantages.speedDesc: Some recorded applications show higher speed than oxygen cutting. Treat every value as case data, not a universal result.
advantages.burrsDesc: Recorded test cuts may show less dross or secondary finishing on suitable jobs. Edge quality still depends on the complete process conditions.
advantages.costDesc: Use the supplied electrical data and compare complete alternative gas-system power demand under the same production schedule.
advantages.maintDesc: Review the supplied inspection and maintenance schedule for valves, regulators, sensors, connections, piping, and gas-supply equipment.
advantages.oneToTwoDesc: A shared station may be feasible after total demand, pressure loss, flow capacity, piping, controls, and each machine interface are checked.
advantages.lensDesc: Gas source quality, regulation, filtration, piping, and operating practice all affect contamination risk. Follow the laser and gas-system requirements.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Which products are included in the GasMixTech assist-gas system?
faq.a1: The current product family covers an optional PSA nitrogen source plus two alternative N₂/O₂ mixed-gas controllers: the integrated cabinet and MSPV2_4000 compact valve.
faq.q2: Do I need a PSA nitrogen generator?
faq.a2: Not necessarily. PSA is an optional upstream nitrogen source. Retain an existing nitrogen supply when it already meets the confirmed purity, pressure, flow, and operating requirements.
faq.q3: Should the integrated cabinet and MSPV2_4000 be installed together?
faq.a3: No. They perform the same core mixed-gas control function in different product forms. Choose one according to installation space, interfaces, and integration responsibility.
faq.q4: Does pure-nitrogen cutting require a mixed-gas controller?
faq.a4: No. Pure-nitrogen cutting bypasses the mixed-gas controller. A controller is selected only when the reviewed process requires an N₂/O₂ mixture.
faq.q5: How do you confirm compatibility with my laser?
faq.a5: Compatibility cannot be confirmed by brand or power alone. We review assist-gas demand, gas sources, pressure, flow, material range, machine interface, piping, and installation conditions together.
faq.q6: Where can I review operating impact and cutting parameters?
faq.a6: Use the dedicated ROI review and parameter pages. Their values are reference inputs and must be checked against your local operating data and complete process conditions.
faq.q7: Which product does the current cutting evidence belong to?
faq.a7: The current published parameter tables and recorded cutting videos remain attached to the integrated cabinet platform. They must not be treated as universal evidence for the compact valve.
faq.q8: What information is required before quotation?
faq.a8: Send the laser brand and power, materials and thicknesses, current gas method, nitrogen and oxygen sources, available pressure and flow, installation space, and production objective. For a qualified One-to-Three multi-machine review, also provide simultaneous demand, pipe routing, and each machine interface.
